ui.common.time.yesterday_at.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.

placeholders.time: Runtime value; preserve the placeholder and insert it without translation.

ui.common.time.today_at.role: Day-and-time divider label above a chat message that follows a gap, for a message sent today
ui.common.time.today_at.length: Two or three words; sits in a thin divider line.
ui.common.time.today_at.note: Pairs with yesterday_at, weekday_at and date_at; the day word and the clock may swap places if the language reads that way.

placeholders.time: A clock reading or date inserted by the app already formatted for the locale; insert it unchanged.

ui.common.time.yesterday.role: Short date label on a chat message's hover row for a message sent the previous calendar day
ui.common.time.yesterday.length: One word; sits in a narrow meta row.
ui.common.time.yesterday.note: Stands alone (no clock). For the divider label with a clock use yesterday_at.

ui.common.time.weekday_at.role: Day-and-time divider label above a chat message sent earlier this week
ui.common.time.weekday_at.note: {weekday} is the full weekday name already in the locale (for example Monday); keep it first or last as the language reads naturally.

placeholders.weekday: Full weekday name, already localised; insert unchanged.
placeholders.time: A clock reading or date inserted by the app already formatted for the locale; insert it unchanged.

ui.common.time.date_at.role: Day-and-time divider label above a chat message sent more than a week ago
ui.common.time.date_at.length: A long date plus a clock.
ui.common.time.date_at.note: {date} is a long calendar date already in the locale (for example November 5, 2026). The joiner between date and clock is yours to choose (comma, space, 'at').

placeholders.date: Long calendar date, already localised; insert unchanged.
placeholders.time: A clock reading or date inserted by the app already formatted for the locale; insert it unchanged.
